verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page mention of a first-party 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail', which suggests natural-language interaction within one app. Nothing documents what commands it accepts or whether natural language can operate the wider product. Meet's 'Take notes for me' is an adjacent AI feature, and Apps Script is a low-code automation tool, so neither counts as natural-language control. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions Gemini can perform from natural-language commands, coverage beyond Gmail (Docs, Drive, Calendar, Admin console), natural-language admin operation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
